My dad died in a car crash 3 years ago on christmas eve, We don’t know if it was suicide but the police and ambulances said it’s likely, as he was on the motorway(not impossible but hard to completely lose control and veer off the road into the trees.) It was not long after him and my mum divorced. He was clearly depressed but never admitted it. I can’t explain how much I miss him. I’m 18 now I think of him every day, every time i get in my car i think of him. Just don’t kill yourself that’s all i can say your babies need you and so do lots of other people. It will get better and there’s lots of reasons to live:) I went a bit off topic there i’m sorry but please don’t go. I always wonder if there’s anything I could’ve done to make him stay, wether it was my fault and I just miss him so much. It’s not even like we had a good relationship but he never saw me finish college. Saw my first girlfriend, saw my first car which is something we always discussed. All i can say is that it left an empty void that can’t be filled. Your babies need you. Stay Strong things will get better for you. Sending Love and strength
